repairs.correction: 아래 ruleChecks에 기록된 최종 조건·대상·단위로 최소 수정; before 원본과 candidate 비교 가능
repairs.quote: Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing (40/60/80/100/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage to nearby enemies. Enemies at the edge of the slice take (60/90/120/150/180 + (75% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage + 4/4.5/5/5.5/6% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead. Deals an additional 50 bonus physical damage to monsters. Additional Maximum Health damage capped to 400 against monsters.
